lines: Kittle's usage has climbed lately: he played 88% of snaps over his last 3 games versus 79% for the season, with a 29% target share.
Over his last 3 games he's averaging 8.7 targets, 6.0 catches and 73.3 receiving yards, good for 12.7 PPR points a game.
Week 11 is against MIN, which allows the 32nd-most PPR points per game to tight ends. SF has an implied team total of 24.8 points.
